Name: Meshullam, Father of Sallu
Summary: Father of Sallu in the Jerusalem list, son of Hodaviah son of Hasenuah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:7: Father of Sallu in the Jerusalem list, son of Hodaviah son of Hasenuah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Meshullam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
